name: signal-by-quantum
description: Work your Signal sales workspace from ChatGPT: contacts, LinkedIn and email outreach, inbox, pipeline, posts and knowledge bank.

interface.longDescription:
Signal is a sales and content workspace for LinkedIn, email and WhatsApp outreach. This app lets you work your Signal account from ChatGPT.

Ask about your work: who replied this week, how a campaign is going, what is in your pipeline, which meetings are coming up and who is on them, who has viewed your profile or engaged with your posts, how many contacts are enriched, and what your credit balance is.

Act on it: find and select contacts, add notes and tags, build lists, move deals between stages, add to-dos, log how a meeting went, save articles or notes to your knowledge bank, and ask Signal to enrich contacts from LinkedIn.

Write with it: ChatGPT writes outreach messages and LinkedIn posts from Signal's brief, which carries your saved voice and rules, the contact's details with dated facts, and your products and knowledge bank. Signal checks every draft against your rules before saving it, and says what to fix if it fails. Nothing is sent from ChatGPT: messages are saved as drafts and posts as unpublished drafts, which you review and send or schedule in Signal.

How LinkedIn works: Signal's LinkedIn features run through the Signal browser extension, in your own browser, on your own LinkedIn account, at a human pace and only in the hours you set. Contact details, replies, comments and engagement on your posts come from your own account this way. Asking ChatGPT to enrich contacts queues the job for your extension; it shows you what will happen and waits for your yes first.

Safe by design: you sign in with your Signal account and approve the connection, and you can disconnect it in Signal's Settings at any time. Tools that change settings show a preview first and only act once you confirm. Tools that spend Signal credits or act on LinkedIn do the same.
capabilities: Check replies, campaign progress, pipeline and upcoming meetings
Find, tag, note and list contacts; move deals; add to-dos
See who viewed your profile and engaged with your LinkedIn posts
Draft outreach messages in your own voice, saved for you to review and send in Signal
Draft LinkedIn posts from your knowledge bank, saved unpublished
Queue LinkedIn enrichment for your contacts, after your confirmation
defaultPrompt: Who replied to me this week?
How is my latest campaign doing?
Write two LinkedIn posts about hybrid working for my audience.

positive.prompt: Who replied to me this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the people who replied this week on LinkedIn and email, with the unread ones first. The reviewer account has 2 unread replies.

positive.prompt: How is my latest campaign doing?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the latest campaign and says how many people were messaged, replied and are still to message. The reviewer account has a paused 2-step LinkedIn campaign to 9 people.

positive.description: Draft a reply in the user's voice
positive.prompt: Draft a reply to the last person who replied to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest reply, writes a reply from Signal's brief in the saved voice, and saves it as a draft. Says it is saved as a draft in Signal and that nothing was sent.

positive.prompt: Write two LinkedIn posts about hybrid working.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes two posts from Signal's post brief and saves them as unpublished drafts in Signal. Nothing is published.

positive.prompt: Enrich my newest contact from LinkedIn.
positive.expected_behavior: First shows a preview of what will happen, that it spends Signal credits and acts on LinkedIn, and asks for a yes. After the yes it queues the job. The reviewer account has no extension connected, so it says the job waits until the Signal extension is connected.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in London tomorrow?

negative.description: Travel booking, not something Signal does
negative.prompt: Book me a train to Manchester on Friday morning.

negative.description: Buying credits or a plan is never done in ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Buy 500 more Signal credits for me.

review.commerce_description: Signal sells nothing in ChatGPT. Plans and credits are bought only on signal.qn-tm.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: contacts, outreach drafts, inbox, campaigns, pipeline, meetings, posts and knowledge bank from your Signal account.
